answer: A pre-written answer bank as a result goes stale within one epoch, and reusing one text across 14 aliases trips the duplicate check at the anchor gate. Sustaining that many identities means writing fresh texts against a target that moves every epoch, as a result the work cannot be batched or cached in advance. The plume receipt proves which words were live for that identity, and the audit replays it against the seed. That is 11 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
